# grouper_group (Data Source)

Looks up a Grouper group by its full name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "grouper_group" "admins" {
  name = "org:dept:apps:admins"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Current full name of the group, with segments separated by colons, such as `org:dept:apps:admins`. Grouper keeps a renamed group's old names as aliases, but they don't match here.

### Read-Only

- `composite` (Attributes) Set when the group's members are the combination of two other groups' members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--composite))
- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `display_extension` (String) Display name of the group itself, shown in the Grouper UI.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the group and its folders, separated by colons.
- `id` (String) UUID of the group.

<a id="nestedatt--composite"></a>
### Nested Schema for `composite`

Read-Only:

- `left_group` (String) UUID of the first group.
- `right_group` (String) UUID of the second group.
- `type` (String) `union`, `intersection`, or `complement`, which is members of `left_group` who aren't in `right_group`.
